red_tests.failure_fingerprint: test_rotated_refresh_token_is_persisted failed with 'assert [] == [(rotated-new, pphothidaen/HoroConsultant)]' after the persist call was replaced with a no-op, and test_workflow_refreshes_token_before_use failed with 'refresh must run before the Jira query' after the Refresh TWG access token step was removed from orchestrator-dispatch.yml. Both confirm the tests fail when the behaviour they pin is removed.

rationale: KAN-264: Atlassian forces rotating refresh tokens on new 3LO integrations, so the TWG access token expires in ~8h. GitHub runners are ephemeral, so twg auth refresh has no stored credentials to refresh and the refresh_token grant has to run in the workflow. The rotated refresh_token must be written back to the repository secret or every later run starts from a token Atlassian has already invalidated. Unconfigured runs exit 0 so provisioning delay cannot raise an SLO breach.
